fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Leases ending within 60 days surface first

Every lease at Birch Court sits in one table, sorted by end date. Anything ending within 60 days rises to the top, and the property manager gets an email to start the renewal conversation. All 48 units stay in one view instead of a folder of PDFs.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { roomRentals: "I rent out a spare room month to month and need a rental agreement form for my new tenant. Ask for a move-in date and an emergency contact. Show my house rules: quiet after 10 pm, and overnight guests for 3 nights at most. Rent is $950, due on the 1st. Send the agreement for signature when they submit.", multiUnitBuildings: "I manage the 48 units at Birch Court. Build a rental agreement form for new tenants and keep every signed lease in one table with unit, tenant, monthly rent, and end date. Sort the table by end date and email me when any lease is within 60 days of ending so I can start the renewal.", roommateHouseholds: "Set up a shared rental agreement for three roommates on one lease. Rent is $2,400 a month, $800 each. Send every roommate a personal signing link that shows their share. Remind anyone who has not signed after two days, and email the finished agreement to all three once the last person signs.", vacationStays: "I rent out a lake house for short stays. Build a booking form with a rental agreement guests accept before booking: check-in at 4 pm, checkout by 11 am, six guests at most. Collect a $300 damage deposit through Stripe and confirm the stay only after the guest signs." };

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: A room tenant fills in a move-in date and an emergency contact on a phone, accepts house rules with quiet after 10 pm and $950 rent due on the 1st, and the agreement goes out for signature.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A lease table for Birch Court sorts units by end date, flags two leases ending within 60 days and emails the property manager a renewal reminder for unit 4B.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A shared lease for three roommates shows two signatures in, each with an $800 share of $2,400 rent, and a reminder emailed to the roommate still unsigned after two days.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A lake house booking form shows check-in at 4 pm, checkout by 11 am and a six-guest limit, collects a $300 damage deposit through Stripe and confirms the stay once the guest signs.
